evidence.title: 课农轩
evidence.locator: v2 p.254, under 北远山村; source ref 6-367
evidence.excerpt_zh: 何以消几暇，临轩自课农。知依民食重，力作稔年逢。枫灿绚秋色，菊含耐老容。连朝欣降泽，可冀候和雍。
evidence.summary: Poem 课农轩 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1817, filed by the editors under 北远山村.

evidence.title: 题课农轩
evidence.locator: v2 p.254, under 北远山村; source ref 6-320
evidence.excerpt_zh: 碧溪曲折放舟通，临水轩窗波影笼。树艺力田始御苑，课农教稼本豳风。披薰柳荫摇汀绿，映日榴花照槛红。麦未登场待甘泽，授时念切近天中。
evidence.summary: Poem 题课农轩 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1817, filed by the editors under 北远山村.

evidence.title: 课农轩: rebuilt from 北远山村
evidence.locator: 三幅样式雷 section 二; 圆明园新证 table
evidence.summary: 课农轩 replaced 皆春阁 and neighbouring buildings of 北远山村 in 1816-17 by these two articles. It stood after 1860 and served works of 1896. S47 p.126 records offerings at its 观音庵 in 1861.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
